Consider the square region $Δ$ in the $uv$-plane, given by

$$
Δ={(u,v)\,:\,0\le u\le 1,\,0\le v\le 1},
$$

and the transformation $T,$ given by

$$
T:(u,v)\to (x(u,v),y(u,v)),
$$

where 

$$
x={u}^{2}+{v}^{2},\,y=-v.
$$

Which of the following is the image of the side ${S}_{2}$ under the action of $T?$

choices.value: An arc of a right-opening parabola, traversed from $(2,-1)$ to $(1,0).$
An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(2,-1)$ to $(1,0).$
An arc of a right-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,0)$ to $(2,-1).$
An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,0)$ to $(2,-1).$
An arc of an upward-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,1)$ to $(2,1).$
